test_overview: Evaluated all 6 steps of the Browse search/filter/sort test plan against the Flask marketplace app at localhost:8000. Step 1: Created 5 products in order (Electric Guitar, Leather Strap, Drum Kit, Acoustic Guitar Case, Piano Bench) via the create-listing flow with image uploads and distinct seller emails; all verified present in Browse view. Step 2: Searching 'guitar' (lowercase) matched Electric Guitar, Leather Strap (description match) and Acoustic Guitar Case while excluding Drum Kit and Piano Bench; search persisted after opening a product detail and returning via the in-app Back to Browse link. Step 3: With the search active, Electronics-only category filter kept all 3 matches; switching to Home & Garden-only produced 0 results with a 'No products match your search' empty state and reset action. Step 4: Cleared search via explicit clear button and reset filters; default sort 'Newest First' order was Piano Bench, Acoustic Guitar Case, Drum Kit, Leather Strap, Electric Guitar exactly matching creation order. Step 5: 'Price: Low to High' sorted correctly ascending ($29.99 → $799.99). Step 6: 'Price: High to Low' sorted correctly descending ($799.99 → $29.99). Every action and verification in the test plan passed, including all non-fatal sub-checks. Total: 36/36.

steps.description: setup_create_five_products: Created all 5 products in order through the app's create-listing flow (with image upload, distinct seller emails, ~1s spacing). After navigating to Browse, all five products (Electric Guitar, Leather Strap, Drum Kit, Acoustic Guitar Case, Piano Bench) were present — 5 items found.

test_search_case_insensitive: Searching 'guitar' (lowercase) returned exactly the 3 expected matches: Electric Guitar (title), Leather Strap (description), Acoustic Guitar Case (title). Drum Kit and Piano Bench were correctly excluded. Search persisted across product-detail navigation and returning via Back to Browse (input still 'guitar', same 3 results).

test_search_combined_with_category_filter: With 'guitar' search active, selecting ONLY Electronics kept all 3 guitar products visible (3 items found, only Electronics checked). Changing to ONLY Home & Garden yielded 0 items found with explicit empty state 'No products match your search' and a Reset Filters action.

test_default_sort_newest_first: Cleared search with the explicit clear button and reset all filters via Reset Filters. Default sort control showed 'Newest First' and product order was Piano Bench, Acoustic Guitar Case, Drum Kit, Leather Strap, Electric Guitar — exactly matching newest-to-oldest creation order.

test_sort_price_low_to_high: Sorting by 'Price: Low to High' produced exact ascending order: Leather Strap ($29.99), Acoustic Guitar Case ($99.99), Piano Bench ($149.99), Drum Kit ($599.99), Electric Guitar ($799.99).

test_sort_price_high_to_low: Sorting by 'Price: High to Low' produced exact descending order: Electric Guitar ($799.99), Drum Kit ($599.99), Piano Bench ($149.99), Acoustic Guitar Case ($99.99), Leather Strap ($29.99).
